gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bona-nova-sc: Balsamiq Sans draws every stroke like a stencil channel, bold and unpinched. Bona Nova SC follows with gentle modulation and open little counters, so paragraphs of text move along without any clogging or strain.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gentium-book-plu: Expressive, bold Balsamiq Sans keeps one constant stroke width throughout. Gentium Book Plus reads traditionally, its thin strokes about half the thick ones and its openings wide, so pages of text flow along easily.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-martel: Martel brings a moderate, editorial contrast beside Balsamiq Sans, whose heading strokes never shift in weight. Martel's open apertures, like a horseshoe magnet's end, carry paragraphs of serif text forward without snagging.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP reads literary and steady, faintly modulated, beneath the bent-paperclip strokes of Balsamiq Sans. Noto Serif JP holds a comfortable midpoint between flat strokes and dramatic ones, and that moderation is its best quality.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-kr: Poured-ink headings, gentle curves below: Balsamiq Sans holds one width throughout. Noto Serif KR's mild thickness shifts and barely curled wide s curves smooth the reading pace, its best quality.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-petrona: Petrona reads dignified and editorial, its contrast so tempered you only notice it on a close look, never jolting. Balsamiq Sans earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-poly: Bookish Poly sits under glass-tubing letters from Balsamiq Sans. Its bowls thin slightly at the sides and its terminals pull back, so text reads with a literary, mild stress.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-stix-two-text: STIX Two Text keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, a traditional, editorial serif. And Balsamiq Sans, with no calligraphic thinning, supplies the bold, expressive headings while the text steps back.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-trocchi: Trocchi reads dignified and classic, its c a wide-open ring and its bowls thinning gracefully. And Balsamiq Sans, with its neon-tube width, can go large for headings while Trocchi stays modest in text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-vollkorn-sc: Vollkorn SC has medium contrast and terminals cut well short of the bowl, with loose, slack-rope tracking. But Balsamiq Sans, drawn like wire, does bold display best, while Vollkorn SC does literary text best.
